concepts.title: Locker Puzzle and Factor Parity
concepts.formula: open_locker = (number of factors is odd) i.e. locker number is a square

questions.q: Fermat's Last Theorem says x^n + y^n = z^n has no positive solutions for n > 2. For n = 3 compute 5^3 - (3^3 + 4^3) to see it is not zero.

Find the square of 39.

A Pythagorean triplet starts with 2m = 18. Using the triplet (2m, m^2 - 1, m^2 + 1), find the largest member.
